text:
Jess (eng-platform): Quick sync — kicking off a v2 compatibility checkpoint. Plan: freeze public v2 API changes Thu EOD, start canary rollout Mon. Need confirmations on SDK bump, runtime flag, and infra quota. @Sam @Cal

Sam (sdk): Got it. Uploaded SDK pre-release v2.1.0-beta to npm and PyPI test index. Will open PRs for migration guide + compatibility tests. Link: https://git.redwood/dev/sdk/pulls/412

Cal (eng-runtime): Can add runtime feature flag `v2_route` and routing fallback to v1. One blocker: kernel pin for aarch64 int8 path — patch ETA Wed. Also need to expose a short-lived header `x-rw-compat` for tests.

Marco (prodops): Cluster capacity ok but will reserve 2x GPU for canary to ensure fast rollback. Need a maintenance window for config push — Sun 23:00 UTC ok?

Jess (eng-platform): Sun 23:00 works. Sam — can you deliver migration notes + compat test matrix by Wed EOD? Use this example snippet for migration guide:

```
# curl example toggling compatibility header
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "x-rw-compat: v1-fallback" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-v2","prompt":"hello"}'
```

Sam (sdk): Will do. I'll add unit + e2e tests that flip `x-rw-compat` and assert deterministic fallback behavior.

Cal (eng-runtime): Canary plan proposal: 1% traffic for 24h -> 10% for 48h -> 100% if stable. Error threshold 5% (5xx or correctness regressions) triggers auto-rollback. Rollback window 30m.

canary-bot: Deploy scheduled: v2-canary-2027-09-01T02:00Z -> monitoring: https://monitoring.redwood/alerts/8234

Marco (prodops): Noted — I'll wire up autoscaling policy to handle potential token throughput spikes during 10% phase.

Jess (eng-platform): Owners: SDK = Sam, Runtime = Cal, Infra/ProdOps = Marco. I'll draft the deprecation announcement for v1 and target publish date 2027-10-01 if no major blockers. Any last blockers?

Sam (sdk): none from me
Cal (eng-runtime): none
Marco (prodops): none

Jess (eng-platform): Great — thanks everyone. I'll update the roadmap ticket and post a short async recap in #product and #support. :thumbsup:
